About Us

Local detailing, done with care

Luxe Mobile Auto Detailing has been serving the Tri-Valley since April 2026. We are a two-person team focused on providing thorough interior and exterior detailing at your home or another convenient location.

We bring our own detailing supplies, hose, and extension cord. Customers only need to provide access to an outdoor water faucet and a standard power outlet.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How is pricing determined?

Pricing depends on your vehicle's size and its current condition. Submit a quote request for an exact price before booking.

Do I need to provide water or power?

Yes. Please provide access to an outdoor water faucet and a standard power outlet. We bring our own hose and extension cord.

How far in advance should I book?

Please request your appointment at least one day in advance. We confirm pricing and availability by text.

What areas do you serve?

See the service area list to the left. If you're unsure whether we cover your location, contact us directly.
